channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula tem 47% e Flávio Bolsonaro soma 43% no 2º turno, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Lula with 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 43% in a potential second round, placing both candidates at the threshold of a technical tie. The result indicates a highly competitive race for the October presidential election.

item.title: Datafolha: Tarcísio lidera disputa para o governo de São Paulo com 45%; Haddad tem 27%
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on August 21, 2026 shows that Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads the race for governor of São Paulo with 45% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad (PT) at 27%. In a hypothetical runoff, Tarcísio would defeat Haddad by 54% to 35%. The poll surveyed 1,610 voters in 65 São Paulo cities on August 18-19, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa do lançamento de Patrus ao governo de Minas
item.description: President Lula attends the launch of Patrus Ananias for Minas Gerais governor at an event in Praça da Estação. Before the event, he visits the São Raimundo bridge. This marks his first campaign trip to Minas since Patrus's candidacy.

item.title: Brasil e EUA marcam reunião sobre tarifaço para a próxima semana
item.description: Brazil and the US scheduled a meeting over tariffs on Brazilian goods after a call between Lula and Trump, with plans for a videoconference next week to resume technical negotiations.

item.title: Tarcísio lidera em SP com 45% contra 27% de Haddad, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolba poll released August 21 2026 shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading at 45% against Fernando Haddad (PT) at 27% in the São Paulo gubernatorial race; in a runoff, Tarcísio would win 54% to 35%.

item.title: Os novos números do Datafolha sobre a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A new Datafolha poll shows Lula leading with 39% in the first round, while Flávio Bolsonaro has 33%. In the runoff, both are tied within the margin of error, with Lula at 47% and Flávio at 43%.

item.title: Lula tem 47% e Flávio, 43%, em 2º turno, diz Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in a potential runoff, within the margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 39% versus Flávio's 33%. The survey interviewed 2,058 voters with a 2-percentage-point margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha mostra Lula com 47% no 2º turno, contra 43% de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in a runoff, within the margin of error. The president maintains a numerical lead, but the race remains technically tied.

item.title: Datafolha: Celina Leão e Arruda empatam nas intenções de voto pelo governo no DF
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Celina Leão and José Roberto Arruda tied at 28% in voter intentions for the Distrito Federal governorship. Leandro Grass (PT) ranks third with 11%, while other candidates trail with lower percentages.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial; Flávio aparece com 33%
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula (PT) at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 33% in the first round of the 2026 presidential election. Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Romeu Zema (Novo) are statistically tied for third with 5%, 4%, and 3%. In a simulated runoff between Lula and Flávio, the incumbent leads 47% to 43%.

item.title: “Quero apresentar o relatório em setembro”, diz relator da 6 X 1
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz (PSD-AM), rapporteur of the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale in the Senate's CCJ, pledges to present his report in early September. The proposal, already approved by the Lower House, aims to reduce working hours to improve workers' mental health and family life, though the electoral calendar may hinder its progress.

item.title: Omar Aziz será o relator do fim da 6×1 na CCJ do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre appointed Senator Omar Aziz (PSD-AM) as rapporteur for the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale and Senator Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE) as rapporteur for the Public Security PEC at the CCJ. The appointments represent victories for the Lula government following its rapprochement with Alcolumbre, aiming to unlock priority agendas and preserve the texts approved by the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Tarcísio x Haddad: Os números da última pesquisa Datafolha para o governo de São Paulo
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 45% of first-round voting intentions, widening his advantage over Fernando Haddad (27%). In a hypothetical runoff, Tarcísio leads with 54% against Haddad’s 35%. The margin of error is 2 percentage points.

item.title: Tarcísio lidera com 45% contra 27% de Haddad em São Paulo, diz pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 45% of voting intentions, ahead of Fernando Haddad (27%) in the first round. In a runoff, the governor would have 54% against 35% for the former minister. The margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no 1º turno; Flávio, 33%; Caiado, 5%; Renan, 4%; Zema, 4%
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 33% in the first round, with a 6-percentage-point difference. The variation is within the 2-point margin of error. Other candidates like Caiado, Renan, and Zema appear at 5%, 4%, and 3%, respectively.

item.title: Favoritos ameaçam transformar a sucessão em guerra de lama
item.description: The electoral campaign advertising on radio and TV debuts next Friday, marking the practical start of the campaign. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who have the largest media exposure, will face off in a direct clash that could turn into a mudslinging war. The expectation is that both will use all the ammunition stored in their committees, potentially making the attacks heavy and inappropriate for minors.

item.title: Após ligação entre Trump e Lula, ministros de Brasil e EUA retomam conversas comerciais
item.description: Following a phone call between Trump and Lula, Brazilian Minister Márcio Elias (Development, Industry and Trade) and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer will resume talks via videoconference next week. The meeting was confirmed by the Brazilian minister to Folha. The move signals a rapprochement in bilateral commercial relations.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula lidera o 1º turno com 6 pontos de vantagem sobre Flávio
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on August 21, 2026, shows President Lula (PT) leading first-round presidential vote intentions with 39%, followed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 33%. Lula's lead over Flávio narrowed from 8 points to 6 points compared to the previous July survey, within the margin of error. Other candidates include Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) at 5%, Renan Santos (Missão) at 4%, and Romeu Zema (Novo) at 3%.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula, 39%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 33%; Ronaldo Caiado; 5%; Renan Santos; 4%; Zema, 3%; Augusto Cury, 2%
item.description: Datafolha poll from August 2025 shows Lula (PT) at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 33% for the 2026 presidential election. The survey interviewed 2,058 voters with a two-point margin of error. 72% of voters say they are fully decided.

item.title: Datafolha - 2º turno: Lula, 47%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 43%
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 47% to 43% in a potential runoff, within the margin of error. The survey, commissioned by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo, also simulated runoffs against other candidates, with Lula ahead in all scenarios.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 54% contra 35% de Haddad no 2º turno em SP, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas with 54% of voting intentions against Fernando Haddad's 35% in a potential second round in São Paulo. The margin of error is 2 percentage points, with 95% confidence.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 47% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 43%, no 2º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in the runoff, with a margin of error of two percentage points. The gap between candidates narrowed from five to four points compared to the July survey. This is the first poll since investigations into Lulinha, the president's son, began.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: Lula tem 47%, e Flávio Bolsonaro aparece com 43% em eventual segundo turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between Lula (47%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (43%) in a potential runoff, within the margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 39% to Flávio's 33%, while Caiado, Renan Santos, and Zema are statistically tied for third.

item.title: Produtores de etanol “repudiam” fala de Flávio sobre revisão do E32
item.description: Ethanol producers repudiate Flávio Bolsonaro's statement on revisiting the E32 rule, claiming it misinforms consumers and undermines established energy policy. The rule, approved in July 2026, increased the mandatory ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32%.

item.title: Durigan defende gradualismo no ajuste fiscal e cita Congresso
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan advocates for a gradual fiscal adjustment due to Congressional constraints, citing the return of a provisional measure restricting PIS/Cofins tax credits. He rejected comparisons with Argentina and emphasized efforts to stabilize public debt, currently at 81.9% of GDP, without increasing spending without identified funding sources.

item.title: Datafolha em SP: Tarcísio, 45%; Haddad, 27%
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads the re-election race with 45% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad (PT) at 27%, according to a Datafolha poll released on August 21. The survey, the first commissioned by Globo and Folha for 2026, interviewed 1,610 people from August 18-21 with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: Datafolha SP: Tarcísio lidera com 45%, contra 27% de Haddad
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 45% voter intention against 27% for Fernando Haddad (PT). In a projected runoff, the incumbent governor would win with 54% of valid votes versus 35% for the former minister. The gap between them has remained stable compared to previous surveys.

item.title: Lobista cobrou chefe de gabinete de Lula sobre acesso a Petrobras: ‘temos que ter algo pra falar’
item.description: The Federal Police investigates messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger to former Chief of Staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola) demanding access to Petrobras. In July 2024, she reported 'Leo' was desperate after not being received by CEO Magda Chambriard, stating they needed 'something to show' or 'it would end'. The probe examines influence peddling suspicions involving President Lula's eldest son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), a close friend of Roberta, cited as recipient of payments from a businessman with MDS contracts. Marcola left the cabinet and campaign after PF identified financial transfers from Roberta to him.

item.title: Juiz dá 48h para Flávio e Nikolas retirarem propaganda irregular
item.description: The Electoral Justice of Minas Gerais ordered Flávio Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira, and Roberta Lopes to remove irregular campaign panels within 48 hours. The panels exceeded the legal 4m² limit per candidate and were flagged by the TSE's Pardal system.

item.title: Em MG, Lula culpa Temer por crise de Pimentel e ironiza Zema
item.description: In a speech in MG, Lula defends Fernando Pimentel and blames Michel Temer for the financial crisis of the PT governor, claiming Minas's debt was never renegotiated. He mocks Romeu Zema, calling him a 'banana peeler' and criticizing his administration. The turmoil weakens PT in Minas, where Patrus Ananias struggles in the campaign.

item.title: Em meio a disputa entre Paes e Ruas, prefeitura do Rio quer destinar recursos dos royalties a comunidades de São Gonçalo
item.description: Rio City Hall formally requested the STF to allocate R$ 300 million in oil royalties to vulnerable communities in São Gonçalo, a move seen as strategically timed for the 2026 election. Eduardo Paes faces strong opposition from Douglas Ruas in the municipality, which has over 650,000 voters.

item.title: PSOL responde à denúncia do Novo por vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro que convocou vigília
item.description: PSOL filed its defense against a complaint by the Novo party, accusing twelve federal deputies and Lindbergh Farias of conduct incompatible with parliamentary decorum. The action was triggered by the parliamentarians' complaint to the PGR regarding a video of Flávio Bolsonaro calling for a vigil for his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Aliado de Zema, Mateus Simões vê voto em Lula combinado com centro-direita em MG e cita ‘Lumões’
item.description: Mateus Simões (PSD), running for reelection as governor of Minas Gerais, identifies the "Lumões" phenomenon — voters combining support for Lula for president with center-right candidates for state offices. He estimates Lula has a floor of 44-45% of valid votes in MG but attributes this to Lula's personal popularity, not the PT, which he considers "destroyed" in the state. Simões predicts center-right victories in state and legislative races.

item.title: Teresa Leitão pede à PGR e à PF informações sobre financiamento de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Senator Teresa Leitão requested information from the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office regarding the financing of the 'Dark Horse' film, which investigates alleged transfers from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, to a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro. She also questioned the existence of procedures related to a legal dispute over a mansion in Angra dos Reis linked to Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Em aceno a Raquel Lyra, Michelle Bolsonaro reposta governadora de Pernambuco nas redes
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) reshared a video from Pernambeuc governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) in a gesture of political proximity, as both compete for different offices. The PL did not field its own gubernatorial candidate in Pernambuco, leaving room for party leaders to maneuver politically. This follows a court ruling that removed misleading AI-generated content linking Lyra to the Bolsonaro movement.

item.title: Em ligação com Lula, Trump quis saber sobre eleições no Brasil e ouviu que processo corre bem e de forma confiável
item.description: In a 1h20 call, Trump inquired about Brazilian elections, and Lula assured the process is running reliably. Lula also rejected the grounds for U.S. tariffs, deeming them unfounded.

item.title: Lula chama Zema de ‘comedor de banana com casca’ e diz que rival não pagou um real da dívida de MG
item.description: Lula attacked Zema in a speech in Governador Valadares, calling him 'banana eater with peel' and claiming he didn't pay MG's debt. The PT leader highlighted federal aid to the state and criticized the opposition, saying the election will be 'truth against lies'.

item.title: Lula defende sistema eleitoral brasileiro em conversa com Trump; temas controversos foram deixados de lado
item.description: Lula defended the reliability of Brazil's electoral system during a phone call with Trump, while controversial topics like the new U.S. ambassador's appointment were avoided. The American president discussed the elections superficially, and Lula shifted the conversation to trade, organized crime, and international conflicts.

item.title: Síria, Bolívia e mais: eleições 2026 reúnem candidatos nascidos em diferentes países; veja origens
item.description: The TSE received candidacy requests from naturalized Brazilians born in various countries, including Syria, Bolivia, Italy, and the USA, for the 2026 elections. The diversity of origins reflects the inclusion of naturalized foreigners, but the registrations still need validation by the Electoral Justice. Additionally, two Portuguese with equal rights also requested candidacy.

item.title: Filipe Martins pede a Moraes para receber Flávio Bolsonaro na prisão
item.description: The defense of Filipe Martins requested authorization from Minister Alexandre de Moraes for the former aide to receive a personal visit from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in prison. Martins was convicted by the First Chamber of the Supreme Court and is held at Ponta Grossa Public Prison. The request was filed this Friday.

item.title: “Quanto menos horas de trabalho, mais se produz”, diz relator da 6×1
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz (PSD-AM), a Lula ally, was appointed rapporteur for the PEC proposing to end the 6x1 work schedule in the Senate. Aziz argues that reducing working hours boosts productivity, stating that 'the fewer working hours, the more you produce'.

item.title: ”Flávio leva vantagem na abstenção”, diz diretor da Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: The director of Paraná Pesquisas stated that Flávio Bolsonaro leads in a scenario of high abstention in the second round, attributing demobilization to the lack of proposals from candidates and the absence of state-level races in several states. He highlighted that states such as Ceará, Bahia, and São Paulo may decide governors in the first round, reducing voter engagement.

item.title: PT cobra Motta para dar posse a deputado em vaga de Odair Cunha, hoje no TCU
item.description: The PT caucus in the Chamber pressures Hugo Motta to seat Gilmar Machado (PT-MG) in the vacancy left by Odair Cunha, who joined the TCU. The TSE ruled for the loss of Glaycon Moreira Franco's (PSDB-MG) mandate and the seating of the PT member.

item.title: PEC da escala 6x1 e PEC da Segurança são oficialmente despachadas para comissão do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre officially forwarded the PEC ending the 6x1 scale and the Public Security PEC to the CCJ, breaking the deadlock caused by his crisis with Lula following the toppling of the attorney general appointment to the STF. Both proposals have rapporteurs close to the Lula government: Omar Aziz (PSD-AM) and Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE). The progress follows the rapprochement between Alcolumbre and Lula, including new partnerships such as the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals.

item.title: Lula faz aceno a caminhoneiros, critica Zema e chama Bolsonaro de 'coisa'
item.description: President Lula made overtures to truck drivers this week while adopting an aggressive tone toward political rivals. He criticized Romeu Zema (Novo), a presidential hopeful, and referred to former president Jair Bolsonaro (PL) as 'that thing.' The remarks reflect the PT's polarization strategy ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Trump dá uma măo a Lula na crise envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: Donald Trump re-engaged with Lula right as Brazilian news was dominated by the leak of information regarding an investigation into influence trafficking involving Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, the president's son. Trump's gesture comes at a sensitive moment for Lula, marked by an internal political crisis. The rapprochement between the two leaders may signal an attempt to ease bilateral relations amid domestic turbulence in the Brazilian government.

item.title: Ex-ministra de Dilma diz que licenciamento ambiental é “politizado”
item.description: Former Environment Minister Izabella Teixeira stated that environmental licensing has been 'politicized' in Brazil, arguing it is an administrative instrument. She spoke at the 25th Lide Business Forum in Rio, on the panel 'Economy, Market and Country,' alongside Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG), who praised Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for advancing oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin and endorsed ending executive reelection.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Dentista do Sítio de Atibaia alugou casa usada por Lulinha
item.description: The Papo Antagonista program revealed that dentist Rafael Nicolau Fioruci Arbex, a defense witness in the Atibaia farmhouse case, signed the lease for a mansion in Lago Sul, Brasília, frequented by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. The property has resurfaced in investigations linking the former president Lula's son to alleged irregularities.

item.title: Moraes volta a permitir visitas de Carlos e Renan a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes reauthorized visits from Carlos Bolsonaro and Jair Renan to former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, but banned any political-electoral purpose. Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, remains barred from visiting his father until October 11, seven days after the first round of elections. Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and 3 months for the January 8 coup plot.

item.title: Ministro brasileiro e representante dos EUA retomam conversas após telefonema de Lula e Trump
item.description: Brazilian Minister Marcio Elias Rosa and U.S. representative Jamieson Greer agreed to resume technical negotiations on tariffs next Monday, following a call between Presidents Lula and Trump. The move marks a concrete outcome of the presidential conversation.
